title: Surreal Parisian Lobster Scene
description: A vibrant surreal street scene in Paris features a giant red lobster exploding from a blue bowl on a cobblestone path. In the background stands the Sacré-Cœur Basilica under a radiant sun, with stained-glass patterns filling the colorful sky above a European street lined with shops and trees.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal scene of a Parisian cobblestone street at sunset with colorful European buildings and flower shops on the left. A giant bright red lobster bursts out of a blue bowl in the foreground, scattering fragments. In the sky, a glowing sun radiates through intricate stained glass patterns and floating diamond shapes. The Sacré-Cœur Basilica is visible in the distance under a dreamy colorful sky, with trees bearing golden leaves on the right and two figures walking in the background.
